parts.quote: Rp(min) = (VDD - VOL(max)) / IOL with "VOL = 0.4 V" at "3" mA: (3.3 - 0.4) / 0.003 = 0.97 kΩ; Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 × Cb) with Fast-mode tr "300" ns: 2.2 kΩ holds up to Cb ≈ 160 pF

layout.rules: Pull-ups to VDDIO (3.3 V): bmi088 p48 "Both lines are connected to VDDIO externally via pull-up resistors".

open_questions: Bus capacitance Cb is estimated (short traces, two sensors), not measured: below ~160 pF 2.2 kΩ meets the 300 ns Fast-mode rise time.
